Description (Faahfahin)

Brand Name: Canon

Print and Copy Speed: Delivers up to 25 pages per minute (ppm) on A4 paper and 12 ppm on A3 paper.

First-Copy-Out Time: Produces the first copy in approximately 7.4 seconds or less.

Resolution: Prints and copies at 600 x 600 dpi.

Scanning Performance: Scans single-sided documents via the standard DADF at speeds up to 35 images per minute (ipm) in black-and-white and 25 ipm in color.

Paper Capacity: Includes a 330-sheet standard capacity (250-sheet cassette plus an 80-sheet multipurpose tray), expandable up to 580 sheets with an optional 250-sheet cassette module: Supports media sizes from A5R up to A3 (60 to 157 gsm).

Processor and Memory: Powered by a 1 GHz dual-core processor, 2.0 GB RAM, and 64 GB eMMC storage (with 30 GB of usable space).

Control Panel: Features a customizable 7-inch (17.8 cm) TFT LCD WVGA color touchscreen.

Connectivity: Supports Gigabit Ethernet (1000Base-T), Wireless LAN (Wi-Fi), USB 2.0, and QR code pairing for mobile devices.

Description (Faahfahin)

Port Layout: Features 16 auto-sensing Gigabit 802.3at PoE+ ports, 8 standard non-PoE Gigabit RJ45 ports, and 2 1G SFP fiber uplink ports.

PoE Power Budget: Delivers up to 95W of total PoE+ output across its 16 powered ports using an internal 120W power supply.

Silent Cooling: Uses a fanless passive heatsink design for completely silent operation in open workspaces.

Front Touchscreen: Includes a 1.3-inch color LCM touchscreen that displays live throughput, port status, IP details, and system alerts.

Form Factor: Built into a 1U rack-mountable metal chassis measuring 17.4 x 7.9 x 1.7 inches and weighing 6.6 pounds.
